title: Mini Waffle Pops with Candy Sprinkles
description: Baked on lollipop sticks and decorated with white chocolate and candy sprinkles, these mini waffle pops make fun and festive dessert bites.

steps.text: Grease a waffle iron with cooking spray and preheat according to manufacturer's instructions.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl.
Whisk milk, beaten eggs, butter, and vanilla extract together in a separate bowl. Pour over flour mixture; stir until batter is just moistened.

Scoop 2 teaspoons of batter into the waffle iron for each waffle pop, leaving space between each one. Insert a lollipop stick 3/4 of the way into each pool of batter. Close lid; cook until golden and crispy, about 1 minute. Transfer waffle pop to a cooling rack. Repeat with remaining batter and lollipop sticks.
Melt white chocolate in a microwave-safe glass or ceramic bowl in 15-second intervals, stirring after each interval, 1 to 3 minutes.
Scoop melted chocolate into a pastry bag fitted with a small writing tip or into a plastic resealable bag with a corner snipped off. Drizzle chocolate over one side of the waffle pops.
Sprinkle candy sprinkles and colored sugar over pops while chocolate is still warm. Let cool until chocolate firms up, about 5 minutes.

video.description: Just when you thought you couldn’t get enough of those fabulous cake pops, a new treat arrived on the dessert block to make all your waffle dreams come true! Bring a sweet treat and bright color to the birthday party, baby shower or brunch gathering with these easy and fun waffle pops! Pour a rich batter in small portions into a hot waffle iron and insert lollipop sticks in each edge as it cooks. Then remove, cool completely and decorate away! Start with drizzles of your favorite chocolate, white or dark, to hold everything in place. Favorite toppings include crushed chocolate sandwich cookies, coconut, chopped macadamia nuts or peanuts, fruit-flavored crisp rice cereal, and of course, candied sprinkles!
